name: 6532-longdecode-qwen05b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine.
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 24 layers, 14 query heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 64, hidden 896, intermediate 4864, vocab 151936, native context 32768, bfloat16, 494M params. Off the published config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=2048, bounded at 8192 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion. `max-num-seqs` is raised to 2048 to match the declared depth, so all streams are admitted into one running batch rather than queued.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 128 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens, both pinned exactly (min = max = the target). Plain completion (`request_format: plain`, no chat template), sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0, n=1.
purpose: A compact half-billion-parameter assistant writing long 512-token replies to short prompts for 2048 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.3.post1-era AsyncEngineArgs: every key here is a field of that dataclass. Do not add
# keys from a later vLLM. `max-num-seqs` must be at least the declared concurrency, or the engine
# queues part of the load instead of admitting it into one running batch.
model: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 2048
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
